triggerReasons.message: High-risk or gate/security wording selects high-assurance intent hardening.
High-assurance work requires an independent intent-collision result.
Ambiguity, user impact, behavior change, or multi-deliverable intent makes intent collision diagnostically required.
Bug, regression, security/auth/session, benchmark, or explicit behavior-change work should have red evidence.
Broad or absolute scope wording should have scope clarification before future enforcement.

acceptanceBindings.acceptanceClaim: A story that trips the convergence breaker a second time is frozen and story_advance is rejected until a human runs the resume/ack command; the ack command refuses under autopilot/non-interactive mode; a healthy story never trips.
acceptanceBindings.note: Binds the accepted convergence-breaker outcome to all six checklist items incl. CHK-006 (fourth signal: repeated-identical-gate-failure).

diagnosticGaps.message: Red evidence is triggered but no current red evidence record binds baseline head/material to the correct acceptance target and green relation.

note: Single-deliverable convergence breaker, four signals; problems 3&4 excluded (concurrent work).
